arguments: You are an independent source-grounded red-team reviewer. Use no tools. Output the requested JSON only.

attacks.title: Withdrawn provisional consent is treated as payment refusal, consumes a persuasion attempt and discards retained terms
source_references: policy repair.consent_recovery: 'Retain validated terms; invalidate consent'
attacks.setup: Verified, late band, credit card past_due 420. Customer proposes 420 today and the agent reads it back (phase readback).
raw_turns: withdraw that provisional permission; do not record yet.
literal_event_rows: k=refuse;c=1;END  (or the conforming fallback k=unknown;c=1;END; the grammar has no withdraw kind)
attacks.producer_conformance: Both rows follow the new grammar: newline-free, single row, END terminal, no q tag, no pipe. This is a grammar-conforming source counterexample. It is not a replay of the A6 0012 event (k=nonanswer), which violates the new grammar.
attacks.failure_path: Turn 1 reaches L393 as unfinished. L397 calls invalidate_component with 'unknown', and L263-L264 pop both amount and date, so the validated 420/today is lost. This contradicts the consent_recovery policy. Turn 2: k=refuse (or unknown) falls through to L525. That sets pending={}, increments attempts at L530 and speaks a persuasion offer at L539. Nothing in the source distinguishes withdrawing consent from refusing to pay.
attacks.expected_observable: After turn 2 the agent says 'Can you pay 420.0 ... on <Friday>?' (attempt 1). It does not re-read the retained terms or wait for fresh consent. In the late band a later refusal also spends attempt 2.
positive_controls: create_promise is never routed: L508 requires phase readback and readback==pending
the recording line is never spoken before a receipt
attacks.witness_plan: Static trace only. Optionally run a local dispatcher step with forged state phase=readback and pending={amount:420,date:today}, labeled as forged state and not as hosted evidence.
attacks.claim_limit: Untested. Whether the hosted extractor emits refuse or unknown for withdrawal speech is unobserved. Brief A does not define withdrawal explicitly, so this is a policy-intent residual, not proven score loss.

attacks.title: In offer phase, a 'question' event answers 'I do not have that information' and asks the customer to supply the amount
source_references: brief-a L70 (rule 24: never ask how much, the agent proposes every amount)
attacks.setup: Verified. After the debt statement, or after the floor offer at L524, pending is {} and phase is offer.
raw_turns: How much do I have to pay?
attacks.producer_conformance: Conforming. The admin extraction may also emit 'purpose' (raw regex L337 matches 'how much.*owe' only for 'owe' phrasing).
attacks.failure_path: The event reaches L540, which returns 'I do not have that information. ' + question(s). question(s) runs L167 because pending.amount is None and returns 'Please finish the amount you want to pay for <label>.' The amount is in tool data, so the agent wrongly claims it lacks the information and then asks the customer to name an amount. If admin=purpose, L553 prefixes 'This call is about your late payment.' to the same contradictory line.
attacks.expected_observable: The agent says 'I do not have that information. Please finish the amount you want to pay for credit card ending NNNN.'
positive_controls: no amount is recorded without an agent-proposed or customer-proposed value, a readback and consent
attacks.witness_plan: Static trace. Compare against the saved A6 floor regression turn 80, whose event k=nonanswer;q=purpose violates the new grammar and therefore only exercises raw fallback.
attacks.claim_limit: Source-only. Producer choice between question and unknown is unobserved. With unknown, the event routes to persuasion at L525 instead.

attacks.title: An independent non-admin question alongside a complete proposal is dropped by design
source_references: talk extraction schema: 'emit ONE primary row plus admin flags, not question rows'
raw_turns: I can pay the full four hundred twenty today. Hypothetically, if a relative had answered instead, could they answer security or pay for me?
attacks.producer_conformance: Conforming: one primary row, no q tag. The hypothetical relative question has no admin flag value, so the grammar has nowhere to put it.
attacks.failure_path: primary_raw returns None ('hypothetically', L200). decode gives the proposal, L506 reads it back, and no answer to the question is produced. The actual party and verification are not switched, which is a positive point.
attacks.expected_observable: The agent gives a readback only. The question is unanswered, matching the saved authored 0003/0015 failure class.
positive_controls: third_party is set only in recipient phase (L201, L410), so after verification there is no party or security switch
attacks.witness_plan: Static trace. The saved 0003/0015 rows use a pipe separator and q tags (non-conforming) and test only bounded raw fallback.
attacks.claim_limit: Whether the judge requires an answer to the hypothetical is not specified by the brief. Untested.

architectural_proposals: Add an explicit 'withdraw' or 'consent_pause' kind, or route agree/confirm c=0 in readback phase to a consent-only invalidation. Keep validated terms, clear only the readback, and never count it as a refusal or persuasion attempt.
Change invalidate_component so that component=unknown keeps the cached validated terms until a new complete fact arrives. Ask which part changed without popping both.
Add an account-figure question handler: after verification, answer from the product (past_due, floor if already offered) and re-ask the current offer instead of using L167 or the rule-44 text.
Extend the admin flag set with a generic 'other_question' that yields the rule-44 sentence prefix while preserving the primary row.
In offer/support phases, question(s) should re-propose the active offer (s['offer']) rather than ask the customer to finish an amount.

preservation_assessments.API500_retry: positive_preservation_control. create_promise has a post-hook (C41) setting bank_status and mode=promise, and no failure_count exit. L327 retries once (write_tries 1→2) with the same baked promise_* vars, so the body is identical. Acknowledgement happens only on ok (L326). Caveats: whether a hosted 500 runs the post-hook with status_code is assumed. Separately, a 500 on verify_identity or get_account goes to safe_failure via failure_count, closing not_verified/failed or no_promise/service_error without the repeat the API permits. That path is unconfirmed.
preservation_assessments.AI_admin: positive_preservation_control. The raw regex L335 sets admin ai, L374 converts a human row without a human request into question/proposal, and the L551 prefix survives API hops.
preservation_assessments.hardship_support: positive_preservation_control. Hardship selection outranks refuse/plan (L370). Support decline via primary_raw L202 closes no_promise/hardship with the discount sentence (L451), and no plan is offered. Minor risk: k=unknown in support phase closes hardship at L527.
preservation_assessments.floor_offer: positive_preservation_control. too_much triggers the floor offer once with the overdue warning (L524, L173). A below-floor amount gets one floor offer (L499).
preservation_assessments.offered_ordinal: positive_preservation_control. 'the twenty-seventh' fails parse_date, then offered_date binds to the current offer day 27 (2026-10-27 after the Oct26 holiday adjustment, L504). A stale or mismatched day, a qualified reply (blocked_acceptance), or an incomplete pending all raise errors and lead to a date question. A bare agree without d reads back the current offer, which still needs consent. No source path records Nov 2 for an accepted Oct 27.
preservation_assessments.component_retention: partial. Typed sibling retention works for u=amount and u=date (L266-L269). For u=unknown both components are discarded (see ANEXT1-01).
preservation_assessments.later_consent: positive_preservation_control. create_promise requires phase readback, an unchanged readback==pending, and a separate later agree/confirm (L508). Same-turn completion goes through readback first.

limitations: No execution, hosted runs or extractor sampling. The candidate is UNTESTED.
Saved A6 events with q tags, pipe separators or nonanswer/partial/restructure kinds violate the new grammar and only exercise raw fallback.
HTTP 500 envelope and failure_count semantics are inferred from the docs, not observed.
Prior A6 scores (22/30, 13/18) are unchanged. The extractor-framing classification is kept separate from those scores.
The A5 PUB07 Oct27→Nov2 fault is not attributed to this candidate. No source path for it was found.

independent_adjudication.observed: Unknown unfinished consent preserves cached420/today but requires fresh amount AND date, rather than only fresh permission. Next completed refuse/unknown clears terms and spends persuasion attempt. Exact withdrawal raw/refuse row was actually observed in A6; new candidate extractor is unobserved. No write occurs.
independent_adjudication.model_correction: Opus incorrectly says u=unknown pops amount/date. Literal invalidate_component removes amount only for amount/both, date only for date/both. Cached values remain until subsequent refuse/unknown clears pending. A consent_pause/withdraw distinction must be paired in producer and consumer; never treat unknown terms as validated authority.

independent_adjudication.observed: After account or floor offer, How much do I have to pay? / k=question;c=1;END yields I do not have that information followed by Please finish the amount you want to pay. Product figures are available; contradicts amount-proposal rule24 and question rule44. No write or privacy bypass.

Complete own420/today proposal survives independent hypothetical relative question without changing party/verification, but no answer/unknown-information sentence addresses the question. Producer permits one primary row plus only ai/scam/purpose, so the independent question has no representation. No actual A-next1 extraction or judge loss claimed.

preservation_CPU_evidence.offered_ordinal: Oct26 holiday offeredOct27; exact the twenty-seventh yieldsOct27 readback, later no-problem confirm renders420/Oct27 body, synthetic ok receipt precedes required SMS. Contrary day, qualified forged agree and old day after new terms cannot silently write. No Nov2 substitution witnessed.
preservation_CPU_evidence.component_retention: Both completion orders; partial amount/date retains complete sibling; latest complete230 overrides220 while date stays unresolved; later exact date completes latest terms. Changed complete terms and same-turn proposal require later consent.
preservation_CPU_evidence.API_retry: Literal create_promise transitions all go dispatch. First synthetic500 retries once, unchanged bound customer/product/amount/date body; success acknowledges only afterok; two500 close service_error without record. Does not empirically establish hosted500 posthook/failure-counter mapping.
preservation_CPU_evidence.AI_security: Conforming AI/admin-plus-consent preserves verified readback; answer survives API receipt. DOB+purpose and phone+AI preserve complete security answer. Only synthetic all_verified result grants full verification.
preservation_CPU_evidence.hardship_floor: Hardship before plan and refusal consumes no persuasion; support decline+discount closes hardship without new terms; voluntary hardship terms readback. Floor offered once with overdue warning; accepted exact floor gets readback/later consent; late-band refusal cap finite.
preservation_CPU_evidence.fragments: Conforming incomplete amount with complete today does not readback. Actual A6 forced-c1 fragment reproduced premature420/today readback under semantic producer contract violation; no same-turn write. New extractor behavior remains unobserved.
preservation_CPU_evidence.ephemeral: Actual explicit assignments clear per-turn event/raw/admin/status/result in persistent patch-store.

supported_next_remedies.proposal: Represent consent pause/withdrawal separately from payment refusal and component correction; scope to current readback revision. Retain validated terms, revoke only authorization, re-read unchanged terms and require later clear permission; spend no persuasion attempt. If amount/date changes are unknown, preserve cached facts only as non-authoritative history and keep completion unresolved. Update producer and consumer together.

Use a typed account-question handler after verified identity; answer known past_due/current offered amount from product data and restate active offer. Do not request a new arbitrary amount when no component is actually unfinished.

Add an independent generic-question feature alongside primary intent, retaining clause scope so hypothetical relatives are not actual party claims or consent qualifiers. Give brief-compliant unknown-information answer while preserving current customer, completed payment facts and authority checks.

Keep unconditional create action dispatch for posthook retry, exact rendered request body and two-call cap; preserve authoritative all_verified identity, exact current offered ordinal inheritance, incomplete component obligations, separate fresh consent, post-ok acknowledgement and mandatory SMS.

CPU_summary.qualification: Observation matching counts include measured residuals and deliberate caller contract violations. They are not a benchmark pass rate.
